text:
{
  "status": "NEEDS_IMPROVEMENT",
  "SYSTEM_INTERPRETATION_OF_USER_INTENT": "The system appears to interpret past purchases as continuing interest in related product families or content, with insufficient attention to the user's current purpose.",
  "WHERE_THE_SYSTEM_GETS_IT_RIGHT": [
    "Recommendations align when they preserve a specific interest, such as a musical style, story theme, or explicit holiday connection.",
    "Recommendations also align when they complement existing equipment or add a capability relevant to an established project."
  ],
  "WHERE_THE_SYSTEM_GETS_IT_WRONG": [
    "Broadly related items compete with stronger matches despite serving different purposes, requiring unsupported projects, or duplicating needs already met.",
    "Older or isolated interactions appear to carry forward without enough attention to recent activity and repeated, specific interests.",
    "Hardware recommendations often lack an established match in compatibility, dimensions, or quantity, weakening their practical usefulness."
  ],
  "OVERUSED_DECISION_PATTERNS": [
    "Shared brand, ecosystem, broad category, or general theme appears to substitute for a concrete reason to choose an item.",
    "Past ownership appears to imply demand for similar devices or supplies, even when another purchase adds little value."
  ],
  "UNDERUSED_OR_MISSED_DECISION_PATTERNS": [
    "Recent behavior interpreted alongside repeated interests provides a more specific indication of current purpose than broad historical similarity.",
    "Useful additions, compatible complements, and unmet needs matter more than familiarity alone.",
    "Fine distinctions in mood, style, format, specifications, and quantity determine which otherwise relevant alternatives users would choose."
  ],
  "PRIMARY_FAILURE_MODE_AT_TOP_OF_LIST": "The top recommendations too often satisfy broad historical similarity while lacking the specific current usefulness or content fit needed to motivate a choice.",
  "DIAGNOSTIC_SIGNALS_TO_TRACK": [
    "The proportion of top-ranked items users select, separated by direct interest matches, useful complements, and broad associations.",
    "The frequency of top-ranked rejections attributed to duplication, incompatible specifications, excessive quantity, or unsupported use cases.",
    "The frequency with which selected items rank below rejected items that share only a brand or broad category.",
    "The share of recommendations whose relevance cannot be assessed because available item identity or descriptive information is insufficient, tracked separately from explicit mismatches."
  ]
}
